description: Advisory spec-versus-submission check. Retrieves cited index passages, then a closed judge label: met, not_met, or ambiguous. Empty or off-topic cite packs are ambiguous. Scores a named requirement only when a packed cite bears on it. structuredContent.rationale names met, unmet, and unaddressed requirements without pasting excerpts. Optional public GitHub PR (github_pr) is packed; private repos fail. Not a merge, payout, or money check. Does not post comments.

caller_ref.description: Optional opaque correlation id. Echoed, not interpreted.

github_pr.description: Optional public GitHub PR URL (https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/n) or ref (owner/repo#n). Packed into the submission. Private repos fail. Not an arbitrary URL fetch.

requirements.description: Optional named criteria strings. When present, the judge scores a criterion 0-1 only if packed cites bear on it; otherwise the score is omitted.

source.description: Optional pin to one corpus source (e.g. github, irc, mail, spec). Omit to search both layers.

spec.description: Natural-language spec or acceptance criteria to check against.

submission.description: Natural-language submission text (description and/or public PR pack).

when.description: Optional date pin YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Keeps cites whose passage date starts with that prefix.

name: analyze_submission
